svg.title: Nour’s World
svg.desc: A playable 3D portfolio. Drive an island where every landmark is a product. Walk through a house that holds the CV. Explore with other visitors in real time. A 2D route for reading instead of driving. Built with Three.js, WebGL, multiplayer. zangeel.dev
